The repaired fixture uses GetFactoryCommands and its stock-faithful mock keeps a positive production queue beside an empty rally queue; an old-API mutant now refuses.

items.statement: Owned native helper children now receive umask 077 through the single subprocess.Popen launch seam. This covers host, engine, receiver and browser without mutating the supervisor process mask. The prior implementation inherited an ordinary 0022 mask and allowed a child FileSink to create a 0644 file before any later verifier could repair custody. The focused regression proves child-created files are 0600, the caller remains at 0022, and actual verify_data_roots accepts the live owned child evidence.
